svg.font-family: "Segoe UI","Helvetica Neue","Liberation Sans",Arial,sans-serif,"Hiragino Sans","Noto Sans JP","Yu Gothic","Meiryo","IPAPGothic",sans-serif
svg.title: Afternoon surface wind over a 40 by 20 km coastal area
svg.desc: Arrows every 2 km show where the air moves; length is proportional to speed (key: 5 m/s). An onshore sea breeze peaks at 6.1 m/s about 2 km inland of the coast and falls to zero 10 km inland, where it meets the easterly; that convergence line is the u = 0 contour.
svg.text: x east, y north; arrows point where the air goes
Onshore wind u along y = 10 km
